subject.title: refactor(whatsapp): centralize inbound turn admission and history finalization

question: Should `mapChannelIngressDecisionToTurnAdmission` become an approved public `plugin-sdk/channel-ingress-runtime` contract, or should this translation remain private until a broader channel SDK need is established?
rationale: The implementation is a bounded refactor, but adding a public Plugin SDK export creates a compatibility commitment that source-level correctness cannot decide alone.

options.title: Approve the narrow SDK seam
options.body: Keep the mapper public as the canonical way for migrated channel receive paths to carry a resolved ingress decision into a shared turn plan.

options.title: Keep the mapper internal
options.body: Retain the shared lifecycle refactor but avoid exporting this function until another plugin demonstrates the same public SDK requirement.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow SDK seam
recommendation.body: Keep the mapper public as the canonical way for migrated channel receive paths to carry a resolved ingress decision into a shared turn plan.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR explicitly involved this reviewer candidate around the channel/SDK decision, while the author can implement either chosen direction.
